Criminal Application No. 393 Of 2026
 Mukesh Munnilal Saroj ...Applicant
 Versus
 The Sr. Police Inspector & Anr. ...Respondents
 __________
Mr. Mateen Shaikh a/w Ms. Muskan Shaikh, learned Advocates for the  Applicant.
Mr. Tanveer G. Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.
PSI Mr. Kalpana Mashere attached to Crime Branch, Unit 6 is present in  the Court.

_  CORAM : ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
DATE : 6th MARCH 2026.

P.C. :
1. Heard Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant and Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.

2. By the present Criminal Application, the Applicant is seeking to quash First Information Report bearing Crime No. 21 of 2026 for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 223, 275 & 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 26(2), 26(2)
(iv), 27(3)(b), 30(2), 37 & 59 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 registered with DCB CID, Unit VI and corresponding C.R. No. 92 of 2026 dated 05.02.2026 registered with Vinoba Bhave Nagar Police Station, Mumbai.

Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.

entities.text: Criminal Writ Petition Nos. 280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

4. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Criminal Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Criminal Application.
He submits that the present Criminal Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions.
5. Mr. Mateen Shaikh, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Criminal Application.
6. Mr. Tanveer Khan, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent does not object to the said request.

7. In view of the above, further proceedings arising out of Crime No. 21 of 2026 registered with DCB CID, Unit VI and corresponding C.R. No. 92 of 2026 dated 05.02.2026 registered with Vinoba Bhave Nagar Police Station, Mumbai, are stayed qua the Applicant.
